title: Shri Thanedar Is Ousted by a Democratic Socialist in a Michigan House Primary
summary: Representative Shri Thanedar is among a wave of Democratic incumbents in Congress whom primary voters have sent packing in a surge of anti-incumbent fervor this cycle.
